# Hermes fixture for limited CI

These are 70 unmodified public source files from Nous Research Hermes Agent commit
b200f5bc60e31588ba2cb60e288029c4a54ba5fa. The original public source archive has SHA-256
1f7d43fa1a515283929a739c42e10bf8d48910e523eccec74b2a2bece858d2b5. A reproducible test-only repack contains
exactly those 70 files and the original MIT LICENSE, with SHA-256 45d1bede19566e032696d41570c9c5b0669fa32bc9e1e6c99cba7f7b8f0b1bf6.
The license is also provided separately as HERMES-LICENSE.txt.

HERMES-FILES.sha256 lists the exact 70 paths and their byte digests. The fixture
contains no .git directory, configuration data, user profiles, or tokens; files
such as hermes_cli/config.py are upstream source code, not profile data.
The verifier checks all archive names, file types, lengths, digests and license
before the unchanged Extract-HermesFixture.py verifies and extracts the 70 files.
No upstream agent process is started by this preparation.
